get.description: Read authenticator status and remaining recovery-code count. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

post.description: Verify current password and return a ten-minute enrollment secret and otpauth URI. Never log the response. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

post.description: Confirm possession. Returns ten recovery codes once and revokes other browser sessions. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

post.description: Verify password and fresh factor, invalidate old recovery codes, return ten new codes once. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

post.description: Verify password and fresh factor, disable MFA and revoke other browser sessions. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

get.description: List up to 100 active browser sessions, without credential hashes. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

delete.description: Revoke one session owned by the current user. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

get.description: Read editable public profile fields. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

put.description: Replace public profile fields. Website must use HTTP(S), without embedded credentials. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

get.description: Read public profile and up to 50 repositories/activity entries visible to the viewer. Disabled users return 404. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup

get.description: Read a Git blob as PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP using byte signatures. Requires repository read access; private no-store, 5 MiB maximum. See docs/ACCOUNT-v06.md. Cookie-authenticated mutations require a same-origin Origin header.

409.description: Concurrent account change or expired setup
